description: This is a React component for a Signup page in a Next.js frontend project, handling user registration via Supabase auth. It manages form state, submission, redirects upon successful signup, and displays success/error messages.

methods.name: SignupPage
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the signup form and handling user registration logic.
